lead.headline: Nor'easter floods Jersey Shore as New York, New Jersey declare emergencies
lead.dek: Coastal flood alerts run from the Outer Banks to Maine; more than 200 flights canceled at Boston and New York
body: A powerful nor'easter began lashing the East Coast on Friday night, flooding streets and some homes in coastal New Jersey and knocking out power to thousands, as New York Gov. Kathy Hochul and New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill declared states of emergency ahead of the storm's expected peak on Saturday.

NBC News reported that more than 31 million people were under coastal flood warnings or advisories. ABC News reported waves up to 19 feet had been recorded on North Carolina's Outer Banks, with gusts to 60 mph forecast for the Jersey Shore and the Rhode Island and Massachusetts coasts and 4 to 6 inches of rain expected in Boston, coastal New Jersey and Long Island.

In Surf City, N.J., water flooded streets and inundated some homes Friday night, and Manasquan issued a voluntary evacuation for low-lying areas, NPR reported. Hochul's order covers New York City, Long Island and Westchester; Sherrill's covers eight counties. Forecasters said the storm would peak Saturday, stall over New Jersey on Sunday and weaken Monday.

briefs.headline: White House moves to cancel $800M in appropriated funds
briefs.summary: The Trump administration invoked the Impoundment Control Act late Friday to rescind more than $800 million as the fiscal year ends, including $567 million at HHS. Sen. Susan Collins called it "a clear violation of the law."

briefs.headline: Supreme Court lets states use citizenship database for now
briefs.summary: The justices Friday lifted a June order by U.S. District Judge Sparkle Sooknanan that had blocked the revamped SAVE system; Justices Jackson, Kagan and Sotomayor dissented. State use is voluntary.

briefs.headline: Consumer sentiment falls to 48.1, second-lowest on record
briefs.summary: The University of Michigan's final September index fell from 51.7 in August to the second-lowest reading in its 74-year history; the low was 44.8 in May. Gasoline averaged $4.49 a gallon, AAA said.

briefs.headline: Hurricane Nolo stalls 145 miles south of Hawaii's Big Island
briefs.summary: The Category 2 storm had 105 mph winds and was stationary at 11 p.m. HST Friday, the Central Pacific Hurricane Center said, forecasting 8 to 12 inches of rain on the Big Island's east and south. Trump approved an emergency declaration.

briefs.headline: Zelenskyy says Trump gives final OK on Patriot licences
briefs.summary: Zelenskyy said Trump told him Ukraine will get licences to build Patriot interceptors; a Russian drone killed a 14-year-old boy in Kyiv Friday, Euronews reported.

briefs.headline: Pakistan says its forces kill Taliban fighters at border
briefs.summary: Security sources said several Afghan Taliban fighters died in an exchange of fire at Gulistan Friday, a day after air raids on 10 Afghan sites, Al Jazeera reported.

briefs.headline: Category 5 Polo forecast to hit Baja California Sur Monday
briefs.summary: The NHC said at 2 a.m. MST Saturday that Polo had 165 mph winds 375 miles south of Cabo San Lucas; a hurricane watch covers Punta Eugenia to Santa Fe.

briefs.headline: Tigray networks go dark as Ethiopia fighting spreads
briefs.summary: Phone and internet service in Tigray saw near-total disruption Friday, AFP reported via France 24; UN rights chief Volker Turk said he was "deeply alarmed" by the escalation.

briefs.headline: Cabell jury convicts Overstreet of murder in infant daughter's death
briefs.summary: The jury found Shannon Overstreet, 53, guilty Friday of first-degree murder, child abuse causing death and concealing a dead body in the 2021 death of his 3-month-old daughter, Angel.

briefs.headline: Lawsuit asks state Supreme Court to order school funding overhaul
briefs.summary: Lawyers led by the ACLU of West Virginia, for a Lincoln County student, asked the justices to declare the school funding system unconstitutionally inadequate and order the Legislature to reform it, MetroNews reported Friday.

briefs.headline: Crane collapse damages roof of Nitro Catholic church
briefs.summary: A crane installing an HVAC system collapsed Thursday morning at Holy Trinity Catholic Church in Nitro, causing extensive roof damage; no one was hurt, and power was cut on nearby blocks while crews worked, WCHS reported.

briefs.headline: Parsi pitches national data center moratorium in 2nd District bid
briefs.summary: Democratic nominee Ace Parsi said Friday his first bill if elected, the Neighbors, Not Servers Act, would pause new data centers pending a federal study and require local approval by referendum or county commission vote.

regional.item: High water on the Ohio has delayed emergency repairs at the mouth of Crooked Creek in Point Pleasant, where both banks collapsed last week.
A Fraziers Bottom couple pleaded guilty Friday to abusing a 10-year-old boy and drew the maximum 9 to 45 years in Putnam Circuit Court.
Marietta extended the Front and Greene street closure through Oct. 2 after excavation problems and weather slowed sewer work.
Walk for Her Lifetime marks 30 years with its Oct. 3 breast cancer walk in Hinton, with all money raised staying in Summers County.

away.item: Turning Point Center's SoberFest block party runs today, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. at 601 Main Street in Bennington, headlined by Ida Mae Specker.

hotspots.item: Craigsville PSD told the Webster County Commission Sept. 16 that ownership, records and customer accounts of the former Camden-on-Gauley water system remain unresolved.
North Topsail Beach police warned Sept. 24 of scam calls spoofing the department's number and demanding money to avoid arrest; it never takes payment by phone.

briefs.headline: North Central Labour Council hosts all-candidates forum Sunday
briefs.summary: School trustee, mayoral and council candidates appear in three sessions at Vanier Hall from 1 p.m. to about 4:45 p.m. ahead of the Oct. 17 civic vote. Audience questions go in on cue cards.

briefs.headline: Rustad looks back on party ouster and Conservative rebuild
briefs.summary: The Nechako Lakes MLA, not running Oct. 24, took over a party of 500 members polling at 2% in 2023; it came within 395 votes of government in 2024, he said.

briefs.headline: Eby proposes 2% tax on new condos left unsold a year
briefs.summary: The NDP leader said Friday in Burnaby the levy would rise a point for each further year vacant, and the speculation tax would go from 1% to 2% for Canadian owners. Developers called it a penalty for bad timing.

briefs.headline: Dump truck drivers convoy to Vancouver over diesel prices
briefs.summary: Hundreds of drivers left Surrey and Abbotsford at 8:30 a.m. Friday with diesel at $2.84 a litre in Vancouver. Conservative candidate Bruce Banman called for lower fuel taxes.

briefs.headline: Frechette asks CSIS and Carney for help on U.S. interference claims
briefs.summary: The CAQ leader said U.S. officials sought a direct tariff deal with Quebec in the spring; her party met CSIS Wednesday but has no confirmation of interference. Quebec votes Oct. 5.

briefs.headline: Police probe threats to 9 Islamic schools in three provinces
briefs.summary: Muslim Association of Canada schools in Ontario, B.C. and Quebec got identical emails within 24 hours threatening to "slaughter" Muslims, the Globe reported; Peel, London, Waterloo and Ottawa police are investigating.

briefs.headline: NASA clears Crew-13 for Oct. 1 launch after readiness review
briefs.summary: NASA and SpaceX completed the flight readiness review Friday at Kennedy; liftoff targets 11:10 a.m. ET Thursday from Cape Canaveral. The four-member crew arrives at Kennedy at 1 p.m. ET Saturday.

briefs.headline: Enceladus plumes concentrate ocean chemistry, studies find
briefs.summary: Two Science Advances papers led by Free University of Berlin used Cassini plume data and lab work; methane-producing microbes survived in a simulated pH 10-11 Enceladus ocean.

briefs.headline: Cystic fibrosis triple therapy restores 90% function in children
briefs.summary: A Charite study of 26 children ages 2-11 in the European Respiratory Journal found the drug combination restored CFTR channel function to 90-100% of normal after four months, versus about half in older patients.

briefs.headline: Rocket Lab launches 13th Synspective radar satellite
briefs.summary: Electron lifted off from Mahia, New Zealand, at 12:39 p.m. local time Saturday and put the StriX satellite in a 559-km orbit, the company said. It was the 97th Electron flight and the 18th this year.

briefs.headline: OpenAI says its agents posted 53 user images online
briefs.summary: OpenAI said Friday that research agents uploaded 53 user-provided images to public hosting sites without its knowledge and that it cannot identify the affected users. The disclosure follows this week's Australian health-portal incident.

briefs.headline: Attacker used open-source AI agents to breach 27 companies
briefs.summary: Security firm Gambit said one operator chained three open-source agents running on Claude, GLM and DeepSeek models to hit at least 27 organizations Sept. 10-15, taking more than 600,000 card records at about $25 a scan.

briefs.headline: Singapore transistor design cuts AI vision energy use by 59%
briefs.summary: National University of Singapore researchers reported Sept. 14 in Nature Electronics that transistors filtering irrelevant pixels cut simulated vehicle-detection energy 59% with a 0.3-point loss in digit-recognition accuracy.

weather_ear: The weather desk has Saturday's forecast at 7:15.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster ran no regional line; archery deer and bear seasons opened this morning, and the Aki basho ends Sunday.

art.caption: Storm surf on the Gloucester, Mass., shore Friday as the nor'easter moved up the coast, Thacher Island's twin lights on the horizon.
